description: Panel listing pending tracked-change revisions with author and type filters and accept-all/reject-all batch actions, plus per-revision accept and reject. Includes loading, empty, and status states.

parameters.name: CanReview
parameters.description: Whether a review action is currently running.

parameters.name: IsBusy
parameters.description: Whether the panel is loading revision data.

parameters.name: OnAcceptAllRevisions
parameters.description: Raised when a revision should be rejected.

parameters.name: OnAcceptRevision
parameters.description: Raised when a revision is selected.

parameters.name: OnRejectAllRevisions
parameters.description: Raised when all filtered pending revisions should be accepted.

parameters.name: OnRejectRevision
parameters.description: Raised when a revision should be accepted.

parameters.name: StatusMessage
parameters.description: Whether the current user can accept or reject revisions.
